🥩 Oven-Roasted BBQ Brisket 🍖 This Oven-Roasted BBQ Brisket is slow-cooked until irresistibly tender, then finished with a rich, sticky barbecue glaze that caramelizes beautifully in the oven. Every slice is juicy, smoky, and packed with bold flavor, making it the perfect centerpiece for family dinners, weekend gatherings, or holiday meals. Ingredients For the Brisket • 4–5 lbs beef brisket, trimmed • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 tsp smoked paprika • 2 tsp garlic powder • 2 tsp onion powder • 1½ tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 1 tsp chili powder • ½ tsp ground cumin For the Roasting Base • 1 large onion, sliced • 4 cloves garlic, minced • 1 cup beef broth • 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce For the BBQ Glaze • 1½ cups barbecue sauce, divided • 2 tbsp brown sugar • 1 tbsp apple cider vinegar Instructions 1. Preheat the oven to 300°F (150°C). Arrange the sliced onion and minced garlic in the bottom of a large roasting pan or Dutch oven. 2. Pat the brisket dry with paper towels, then rub it all over with olive oil. 3. In a small bowl, combine the smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, black pepper, chili powder, and cumin. Rub the seasoning mixture evenly over every side of the brisket. 4. Place the brisket fat-side up on top of the onions. Pour the beef broth and Worcestershire sauce around the meat. 5. Cover the pan tightly with a lid or heavy-duty aluminum foil and roast for 4½–5 hours, or until the brisket is fork-tender. 6. In a bowl, whisk together 1 cup of the barbecue sauce, brown sugar, and apple cider vinegar. 7. Remove the brisket from the oven and generously brush the top with the barbecue glaze. 8. Increase the oven temperature to 425°F (220°C). Return the brisket to the oven uncovered and roast for another 10–15 minutes, until the glaze becomes glossy, caramelized, and slightly charred around the edges. 9. Transfer the brisket to a cutting board and let it rest for 20 minutes before slicing thinly against the grain. 10. Drizzle the sliced brisket with the flavorful pan juices and serve with the remaining barbecue sauce. Serving Suggestions Serve with creamy mashed potatoes, baked beans, buttery cornbread, roasted corn on the cob, coleslaw, mac and cheese, or grilled vegetables for a classic Southern-style barbecue feast. Storage Store leftover brisket in an airtight container with a little extra barbecue sauce in the refrigerator for up to 4 days. Reheat gently in the oven or on the stovetop to keep the meat tender and juicy. Prep Time: 15 minutes Cook Time: 5 hours Total Time: 5 hours 35 minutes Servings: 8 Calories: Approximately 520 per serving #BBQBrisket #ComfortFood #EasyDinner #FamilyMeals #SlowRoasted

VIRAL CHUCK ROAST✨ my most popular recipe for good reason! I’ve received 100s of messages from you about how this recipe has become a staple in your family’s dinner routine 🥹 Some of you are making it WEEKLY and I’ve gotten so much feedback specifically that your kids are loving it - which makes me so happy! Let me know in the comments how YOU enjoy this easy recipe and share it with someone you think would love this crowd-pleasing chuck roast!  Ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast (about 4 pounds) 2 teaspoons kosher sea salt  1 teaspoon black pepper  Instructions: Preheat your oven to 325. Season the roast generously on both sides with salt and pepper. Add to a baking large casserole dish or Dutch oven, cover (with a lid or foil), and bake for 1 hr per pound of meat. Remove the roast from the oven and raise the oven temperate to 425.  Using two forks, shred the meat into large chunks. (If the roast is not pulling apart easily, put it back in the oven for 30 min). Toss the shredded pieces of roast around in the rendered fat and place it back in the oven, uncovered, for 20-25 minutes until you see some nice crispy ends.  Serve with mashed potatoes or roasted vegetables and enjoy! FAQs:  My roast is less than 4 lbs, how long should I cook it? Use the “hour per pound” method. How do I choose a good beef chuck roast? Look for nice fatty roast with lots of marbling. A roast that is too lean will not render enough juice. (Note: I have hit or miss luck with grass-fed roasts. Most are just too tough/lean and don't render enough fat for this preparation.)  How many people does this serve? A 4-pound roast serves 6-7 people. Do I need to sear it first?  Nope! The last part of the cook will give it some nice crispy bits without searing.  Did you add liquid? No, that is the juice rendered from the meat. ✨ Creamy Garlic Chicken & Mashed Potatoes 🤍🧄🥔 🕒 Total Time: ~35 minutes 🍽️ Serves: 4-6 📋 Ingredients: • 2 lbs chicken breasts, sliced in half lengthwise • 2 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp butter • 2 tbsp all-purpose flour • 1½ cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream or half-and-half • ½ cup grated parmesan cheese • Garlic salt • Onion powder • Paprika • Black pepper • Mashed potatoes, for serving 👩🏼‍🍳 Directions: 1. Season chicken generously with garlic salt, onion powder, paprika, and black pepper. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Cook chicken 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through. Remove from skillet and set aside. 4. Reduce heat to medium. Add butter to the skillet and let melt. 5. Whisk in flour and cook for 1-2 minutes to create a roux. 6. Slowly pour in chicken broth while whisking until smooth and thickened. 7. Stir in heavy cream (or half-and-half) and parmesan cheese. Simmer until the gravy is rich, creamy, and silky smooth. 8. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over top. Simmer for 3-5 minutes. 9. Serve over warm mashed potatoes and drizzle with plenty of that creamy garlic gravy. ✨ This is the kind of dinner that has everyone asking for seconds and a piece of bread to clean the plate. 🤍 #CreamyGarlicChicken #DinnerAtRileys #ComfortFood #EasyDinnerRecipe #FamilyDinner

No ratings yet Recipes The Filling 2 pounds bulk ground beef 1 pouch of proprietary taco seasoning blend 1 standard-sized can of yellow corn fully drained 1 standard-sized can of condensed nacho cheese soup The Topping 32 ounce bag of frozen cylindrical potato puffs tater tots 1 ½ cups sharp cheddar cheese shredded Instructions Oven Preparation: Set your oven temperature to 350 degrees Fahrenheit. Cook Meat: Place the ground beef into a large pan or skillet set over a medium-high burner. Stir and brown the meat completely until no pink remains. Once finished, discard all accumulated grease. Seasoning: Reduce the heat beneath the pan to low. Introduce the entire contents of the taco seasoning packet and sauté for two to three minutes. Combine Filling: Incorporate the drained corn and the condensed nacho cheese soup into the seasoned meat. Continue mixing and cooking gently for a maximum of two minutes to fully combine the ingredients. Assemble Base: Transfer the entire warm meat mixture and soup base into the bottom of a 9×13 inch baking vessel that has been lightly oiled or sprayed. Add Potato Puffs: Arrange the frozen cylindrical potato puffs over the meat base in a single, even layer. Initial Bake: Place the dish in the preheated oven and let it cook for a duration of forty-five minutes. Final Cheese Layer: Carefully remove the casserole from the oven. Evenly distribute the shredded cheddar cheese across the top of the potato puffs. Finish Baking: Return the casserole to the oven for an additional five minutes, or until the cheese has achieved a complete melt. Serve: Allow to cool briefly before portioning and enjoying. #fyp #HomeCooking #DinnerRecipe #ComfortFood #Recipe

High Protein Honey Garlic Butter Chicken Mac n Cheese! Only 597 Calories!🍯🧄🍗 Made By: @Jalalsamfit  For All The Best & Simple High Protein Recipes In One Place Follow: @legends_cooking Follow My Main Account: @Mykhaylo  Macros: 597 Calories 59g Protein 52g Carbs 16g Fat Ingredients & Cooking Directions: Make 4 Servings Honey Garlic Chicken: 800g Raw Chicken Breast cut into cubes 1.5 Tsp Salt 1 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (leave it out if you don’t want it spicy) 1.5 Tsp Garlic Powder 1.5 Tsp Onion Powder 1.5 Tep Paprika or Smoked Paprika 2 Tsp Olive Oil 30g Light Butter, for cooking + extra once cooked 2 Tsp Minced Garlic 30g Honey (15g Honey per batch of chicken) Handful Fresh Chopped Parsley Get a pan on medium heat first then add butter. Let it melt then add your chicken (don’t overcrowd the pan). Cook for 4-5 mins on one side first till you get a nice golden brown crust. Then cook the other side for 3-4 mins more. Lower the heat completely when adding the extra butter, garlic and honey. Mix till well coated and sticky then set aside. Garlic Mac n Cheese: Big Tbsp Minced Garlic 300ml Skimmed Milk 160g Light Cream Cheese (Brand: Philadelphia) 1 Tsp Salt or to taste 1/2 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika 1/2 Tsp Nutmeg (adds a great deep flavour!) 100g Low Fat Cheddar Cheese (You can use any low fat cheese you have available) 220g (Uncooked weight) Macaroni Pasta or any pasta of your choice On medium low heat cook the minced garlic in the residue butter from the chicken for 2 mins till fragrant. Then add milk, cream cheese, spices. Mix this till completely smooth then lower the heat before adding the cheddar cheese. Stir till it melts then add your cooked macaroni and give it a good mix then. Enjoy! #legends_cooking #lowcalorie #highprotein #healthyeating #healthyfood

Puerto Rican pollo guisado 🇵🇷🥘🍗🌿 Dinner ready in 30 minutes ⏲️  Chicken marinade  Drums (3x) and thighs (4x) 1 tbsp complete seasoning with adobo  1 tbsp of garlic powder  1 tsp of oregano and cumin 1/2 tsp salt 2 tbsp of sofrito  1 sazon packet  Drizzle of olive oil  Marinate for 30 mins to an hour  Pollo guisado  Half an onion  Half a green and red bell pepper  3 garlic cloves  Half can of tomato sauce  2 bay leaves  1/2 tsp adobo  1 packet of sazon 1/2 tsp chicken bouillon  1 tbsp of sofrito  Olives  2 medium sized russet potatoes  Directions  Clean your chicken and add seasonings, sofrio and oil to chicken and let marinate for 30 mins to an hour. Before cooking chicken take out the fridge to allow it to get to room temperature. In a pan add oil and brown chicken on both sides then remove chicken.  Add your onion and bell peppers to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes before adding garlic.  Add your sofrito, tomatoes sauce, seasonings and olive mixtung together. Allow to simmer until fragrant.  Add your chicken back to the pot with water enough to cover the chicken. Add the potatoes and your bay leaves and let cook for 20 minutes until your potatoes are fork tender.  Service with rice and enjoy ❤️ #polloguisado #chickenstew #puertoricanfood #dinnerideas #recetas

They always ask why I didn’t make more | full recipe ⬇️ Smoked to perfection with @harmosgrill flavored pellets Serves: 6–8  Total Time: ~2–3 hours (including marinade) Ingredients Chicken 3–4 lbs bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs (non-negotiable) 3–4 tbsp spicy brown mustard 2 tbsp Cuso’s Hot Honey Seasoning 2 tbsp Cuso’s Roasted Garlic & Onion Seasoning Grill / Smoke Harmos wood pellets: Spanish Barbecue Pirate & Turkish Barbecue Traveler Jalapeño Green Sauce 2–3 jalapeños (adjust for heat) 1 cup fresh cilantro 2–3 garlic cloves ½ cup Greek yogurt 2–3 tbsp olive oil Salt, to taste Black pepper, to taste Instructions 1. Marinate the Chicken Add chicken thighs to a large bowl. Coat fully with spicy brown mustard. Season generously with Cuso’s Hot Honey + Roasted Garlic & Onion seasoning. Mix until evenly coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least a few hours (overnight preferred). 2. Preheat the Grill Preheat your pellet grill to 350°F. Load with Harmos pellets (Spanish Barbecue Pirate + Turkish Barbecue Traveler) for deep smoky flavor with paprika, garlic, rosemary, and spice notes. 3. Make the Jalapeño Green Sauce Add jalapeños, cilantro, garlic, Greek yogurt, olive oil, salt, and pepper to a blender. Blend until smooth and creamy. Taste and adjust seasoning or heat. Chill until ready to serve. 4. Smoke the Chicken Place chicken directly on the grill grates. Cook for about 1 hour, until internal temp reaches 160°F. 5. Crank the Heat Increase grill temp to 500°F. Cook until chicken hits 180°F internal and skin gets crispy with great color. 6. Serve Remove from grill and rest a few minutes. Serve with the jalapeño green sauce on the side or drizzled over top. #HarmosGrill  #HarmosWoodPellets  #HarmosFlavoredPellets

🍗🔥 8 CHICKEN MEAL PREP IDEAS FOR THE WEEK High-Protein • Easy • Perfect for Busy Days 🍗 1. GRILLED CHICKEN + RICE + BROCCOLI 🛒 Ingredients: • 400 g chicken breast • 200 g cooked white rice • 200 g broccoli • 2 tbsp olive oil • Salt & pepper 👨‍🍳 Instructions: Season chicken with salt & pepper Grill until fully cooked and juicy Steam broccoli until tender Serve with rice and portion into containers 🍱 2. TERIYAKI CHICKEN + RICE + SESAME 🛒 Ingredients: • 400 g chicken • 3 tbsp teriyaki sauce • 200 g cooked rice • 1 tbsp sesame seeds 👨‍🍳 Instructions: Cook chicken until browned Add teriyaki sauce and let it glaze Serve over rice and top with sesame seeds 🍝 3. CREAMY CHICKEN PASTA 🛒 Ingredients: • 300 g chicken • 200 g pasta • 200 ml heavy cream • 2 garlic cloves • 50 g parmesan cheese • Salt & pepper 👨‍🍳 Instructions: Cook pasta and set aside Sauté chicken with garlic Add cream + parmesan → make sauce Toss with pasta and portion 🥡 4. CHICKEN STIR-FRY + VEGETABLES + RICE 🛒 Ingredients: • 300 g chicken • 200 g cooked rice • 200 g mixed vegetables • 3 tbsp soy sauce • 1 tbsp oil • 2 garlic cloves 👨‍🍳 Instructions: Stir-fry chicken with garlic Add vegetables + soy sauce Cook until glossy and coated Serve with rice 🌿 5. BAKED HERB CHICKEN + POTATOES + CARROTS 🛒 Ingredients: • 400 g chicken • 300 g potatoes • 150 g carrots • 2 tbsp olive oil • Oregano or parsley • Salt & pepper 👨‍🍳 Instructions: Season everything with oil + herbs Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 25–30 min Cook until golden and tender Divide into containers 🌶 6. SPICY CHICKEN + RICE + CORN 🛒 Ingredients: • 400 g chicken • 1 tsp paprika • ½ tsp chili flakes • 200 g cooked rice • 150 g corn • 2 tbsp oil 👨‍🍳 Instructions: Season chicken with spices Cook until golden & slightly crispy Serve with rice and corn 🥗 7. CHICKEN CAESAR SALAD 🛒 Ingredients: • 300 g grilled chicken • 1 lettuce • 50 g parmesan cheese • Croutons • Caesar dressing 👨‍🍳 Instructions: Grill and slice chicken Toss lettuce with dressing Top with chicken, parmesan, croutons (Store dressing separately if prepping ahead) 🥔 8. CHICKEN + MASHED POTATOES + GREEN BEANS 🛒 Ingredients: • 400 g chicken • 300 g potatoes • 150 g green beans • 50 ml milk • 2 tbsp butter • Salt & pepper 👨‍🍳 Instructions: Boil potatoes → mash with milk + butter Cook chicken until juicy Sauté green beans Serve together and portion ⏱️ MEAL PREP TIP 🔥 ✔ Store in fridge 3–4 days ✔ Reheat when ready ✔ Keep sauces separate for best texture #MealPrep #HighProteinMeals #ChickenRecipes #HealthyEating

I can’t get anywhere. Something I’ve never seen before,” Trump said of the scene. “And dangerous. We have a lot of buildings still in a form of collapse, so it’s very dangerous and it’s tough.” Trump was having a building constructed in New York City at the time, which he said was “OK” after the attack. He told reporters that he had about 100 workers helping to dig out rubble at the World Trade Center, and another 100 to 150 were “coming.”  At an event this week paying tribute to fallen heroes of 9/11, now-President Trump spoke about his experience visiting the site of the New York attacks.  “I was building a big building in New York and I took the whole crew down there right after this happened and they had no hesitation. Everybody went down with me. We went down as a big group of people. It wasn't too much we could do, I'll be honest. It was raw. Nobody's seen anything like it ever,” Trump said on Sept. 8, 2026, at a ceremony near the White House. He has shared the story about sending workers to the scene to aid in the recovery more than once over the years. Our partners at PolitiFact worked to fact-check his claims, and they were unable to verify that he brought hundreds of workers to help with “digging out.”  The NewsHour footage does not appear to show anyone from a Trump construction crew. In the 2001 video, when asked for his opinion as a developer about the prospect of repairing the damage, Trump said “you can do anything nowadays with the right money and the right talent” and that he thought the city would be rebuilt in “maybe not the same form, but in some form.” “It’s going to take a long time, but they’re tough. New Yorkers are tough,” he said. “The country is tough. And hopefully we’ll — there’ll be great retribution.” #Trump #September11 #WorldTradeCenter #news

Every bite is loaded with flavour🤌🏽 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 650 Calories | 52g Protein | 59g Carbs | 22g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6) Middle Eastern Chicken - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Paprika - 3 Tsp Cumin - 30g Honey - 80-100g Tomato Paste  - 1 Lemon Juice  - 30g Olive Oil Golden Herb Rice - 300g Uncooked Basmati Rice (Cook this beforehand) - 20g Light Butter - 100g White Onion, finely chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1.5 Tsp Turmeric - 1 Tsp Paprika - 1 Tsp Cumin Tabouleh Salad - 3 Cups Parsley, chopped - 300g Tomato, chopped and de-seeded - 150g Green Onion/Scallion, chopped - 15g Olive Oil - Lemon Juice - 1/2 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Sumac - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes Spicy Garlic Sauce - 300g Low Fat Yogurt - 100g Light Mayo - 120g Chilli Garlic Sauce (Lee Kum Kee) - 1 Tsp Paprika  - 1 Tsp Onion Powder - 1/4 Cup Evaporated Milk 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Cherry blossoms are among the most beautiful and admired flowers in the world. Known for their soft pink and white petals, these delicate blooms appear during the spring season and symbolize renewal, hope, beauty, and the short but meaningful nature of life. Cherry blossom trees, often called sakura in Japan, have become deeply connected to culture, art, poetry, and traditions across many countries. Every year, millions of people gather in parks, gardens, and streets to witness the brief but breathtaking blooming season that transforms landscapes into seas of pink and white. Cherry blossoms bloom for only a short period, usually lasting one to two weeks depending on weather conditions. This short life span is one reason they are so admired. Their beauty reminds people that life itself is temporary and precious. In Japanese culture, cherry blossoms represent the idea of living in the moment and appreciating beauty while it lasts. Festivals called hanami, meaning “flower viewing,” are held during the blooming season. Families and friends gather beneath the trees for picnics, music, laughter, and celebration while enjoying the falling petals drifting through the air like soft pink snow. The history of cherry blossoms dates back thousands of years. In ancient Japan, emperors and nobles admired the blossoms and wrote poetry inspired by them. Over time, the tradition spread throughout society and eventually became known around the world. Today, cherry blossom festivals are celebrated in many countries including the United States, South Korea, and China. One of the most famous celebrations outside Japan takes place in Washington, D.C., where thousands of cherry blossom trees bloom around the Tidal Basin each spring. These trees were gifted by Japan in 1912 as a symbol of friendship between nations.#fyp #fyp #fypシ゚viral #foryou #japan

Creamy Peri Peri Chicken Pasta🍗🧀🍝 Another game changing sheet pan meal prep. This pasta tastes unreal, low effort, easy to make for the week!🤌🏽🔥 Macros Per Serving (8 Total) 592 Calories | 55g Protein | 54g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 8 Servings) Peri Peri Chicken - 1500g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, fat trimmed - 3 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 4 Tsp Oregano - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 4 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Parsley - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Coriander/Cilantro - 1 Lemon Juiced - 8 Tsp Olive Oil - 100g Nando’s Peri Peri Medium Sauce (used to brush over the chicken before cooking) - Avocado Cooking Spray (4 Tsp worth) Creamy Peri Peri Pasta - 200-250g White & Red Onion, chopped - 200-250g Red & Green Bell Pepper, chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Oregano - 2 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 120-150g Tomato Paste - 180g Light Cream Cheese - 400ml Light Evaporated Milk - 150g Peri Peri Medium Sauce - 480g Uncooked Protein Rigatoni Pasta / ~800-900g Cooked Pasta - Fresh Chopped Parsley 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from the chicken thighs. Add seasoning, fresh parsley and coriander, lemon juice, and olive oil. Mix until evenly coated and let marinate if time allows. 2. Line a sheet pan and spread the marinated chicken in a single layer. Brush with peri peri sauce and lightly spray with avocado oil. Bake in a preheated oven at 200C / 400F for 22-25 minutes until golden and juicy. While it cooks, boil the pasta, drain, and set aside. 3. Remove the chicken and keep all the pan juices. Add chopped onion and bell pepper, toss in the juices, spread flat, and roast at 180C / 370F for 15 minutes until soft and lightly charred. 4. While pan is hot, add extra seasoning, tomato paste, cream cheese, milk, peri peri sauce. Mix gently until melted creamy - the residual heat will help emulsify sauce. If needed, return to oven for 5 minutes. 5. Stir in cooked pasta and parsley until coated. Slice peri peri chicken, serve over pasta, and ENJOY! . . . #periperichicken #healthyrecipes #pasta #mealprep #sheetpandinner

Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

Marry Me Chicken Tortellini is an easy and delicious dinner recipe the whole family loves!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts, sliced into cubes  1/2 cup of flour  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder  2 TBSP olive oil 2 TBSP butter 2 TBSP of minced garlic 1 cup of chicken broth 1 cup of heavy cream 1 cup of Parmesan cheese 1 tsp of red pepper flakes  1/2 tsp each of oregano and thyme  1/3 cup of chopped sun dried tomatoes 19 oz bag of frozen tortellini  INSTRUCTIONS Mix together flour, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika. Dredge chicken breasts into the flour/seasoning mixture.   In a skillet heat olive oil and butter on medium heat. Cook chicken 4-5 minutes on each side until golden brown and it reaches 165 degrees.  Take the chicken out of the skillet and put aside.  Add minced garlic, sun dried tomatoes, and chicken broth to the skillet. Lower heat and add heavy cream and Parmesan cheese. Stir well.  Add the red pepper flakes, oregano, and thyme. Stir together well and let simmer until it starts to slightly thicken (this could take at least five minutes).  Add one bag of frozen tortellini, cover, and let cook for a few minutes. The tortellini will also help thicken the sauce. Once tortellini is tender add chicken back to the skillet and serve. Enjoy! *This is a little bit spicy with 1 tsp of red pepper flakes, for less heat use 1/4 tsp!  #dinner #chicken #recipes

Recipe Name Smash Burger Tacos Ingredients 1. 1 lb ground beef 2. 6 small flour tortillas 3. 6 slices cheddar cheese 4. 2 cups shredded lettuce 5. 1/2 cup diced onion 6. 1/2 cup diced tomatoes 7. 1 tbsp olive oil 8. 1 tsp salt 9. 1/2 tsp black pepper 10. 1 tsp garlic powder 11. 1 tsp smoked paprika 12. 1/2 cup mayonnaise 13. 2 tbsp ketchup 14. 1 tbsp yellow mustard 15. 1 tbsp finely chopped pickles 16. 1 tsp pickle juice 17. 1/2 tsp garlic powder 18. 1/4 tsp black pepper Recipe 1. In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise, ketchup, mustard, chopped pickles, pickle juice, garlic powder, and black pepper. 2. Stir the sauce until smooth, then refrigerate while preparing the tacos. 3. Divide the ground beef into 6 equal portions. 4. Season the beef lightly with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and smoked paprika. 5. Place one tortilla on a hot skillet or griddle. 6. Press one portion of ground beef directly onto the tortilla, spreading it into a thin, even layer almost to the edges. 7. Cook beef-side down for 2–3 minutes until deeply browned and crispy. 8. Flip the tortilla and beef together, then immediately place a slice of cheddar cheese on top. 9. Cook for another 1–2 minutes until the tortilla is crisp and the cheese is melted. 10. Repeat with the remaining tortillas and beef. 11. Top each taco with shredded lettuce, diced onion, and diced tomatoes. 12. Drizzle generously with the creamy burger sauce. 13. Fold the tacos slightly and serve immediately while the beef is hot and the cheese is melted. 14. Add extra pickles or sauce if desired for an even more classic burger flavor.
